notes: t7 groomed against MERGED reality (main @ 5db0621 = t6 close), re-verified on-tree during this groom: backend/app/auth/ and backend/app/core/ exist as t1 empty packages (no shared error base class -> TokenError is defined locally in app/auth/jwt.py; app/core/exceptions.py is out of scope); backend/app/config.py (t5) already carries JWT_SECRET/JWT_ALGORITHM/JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES(1440)/JWT_ISSUER/JWT_AUDIENCE with get_settings.cache_clear() as the t5/pinned isolation lever, so no config change is needed or allowed. uv.lock resolves python-jose 3.5.0 / passlib 1.7.4 / cryptography 50.0.2 / ecdsa 0.19.2 / rsa 4.9.1 (all fine) and bcrypt 5.0.0.

BLOCKER-GRADE DISCOVERY, resolved with the pre-authorized lock change: bcrypt 5.0.0 as merged is INCOMPATIBLE with passlib 1.7.4. Reproduced on main: CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt'], bcrypt__rounds=12).hash('x') dies with 'ValueError: password cannot be longer than 72 bytes' raised from passlib's import-time backend probe (handlers/bcrypt.py detect_wrap_bug), which would make every t7 password test error at collection. ac5 therefore pins the fix (REQ-TECH-080): add 'bcrypt>=4.0,<4.1' to backend/pyproject.toml dependencies + commit the regenerated uv.lock. bcrypt 4.0.1 was proven against passlib 1.7.4 in this groom (hash -> 60-char '$2b$12$...' string, verify True/False, salt differs, dummy_verify ~0.26 s at cost 12, UnknownHashError for malformed input). ac5 asserts BOTH the pyproject declaration (grep '^[[:space:]]*"bcrypt[>=<]') and the 4.0.x lock resolution (tomllib + tuple compare), so a Builder who skips the pin cannot pass. 'uv lock --check' passes on main, i.e. this is a genuine resolution change, not a stale lock; the shared-venv bucket hash therefore differs from t5/t6 and a fresh sync is expected (stated for the Verifier).

Security ACs kept mechanically checkable and anti-vacuous: ac1 requires the literal '$2b$12$' prefix + len 60 + two hashes of the same input DIFFER (automatic salt) + 'is True'/'is False' (rejects truthy non-booleans) + malformed-hash inputs returning False without raising. ac2 (REQ-BE-032/REQ-SEC-023 timing parity, which the survey drafted and I kept as a real assertion) measures a real verify_password and a verify_dummy call in the SAME test run and pins a >= 0.05 s floor (rejects a pass-only stub; measured ~0.26 s at rounds 12 on this host) AND a <= 10x ceiling vs the real verify (rejects a wrong-cost dummy). ac3 pins set(claims) == {sub,iss,aud,iat,exp,type} (extra OR missing claims fail), sub/type/iss/aud values, exp - iat == 1440*60, and get_unverified_header == {'alg':'HS256','typ':'JWT'} plus a library-level wrong-secret rejection. ac4 splits the seven reject paths into SEVEN separate nodes each pinned to pytest.raises(TokenError) (a single over-broad raises(Exception) is impossible AND ruff B017-banned), with a valid round-trip node included.

Expiry test pinned to be deterministic WITHOUT sleeps or freezegun (the time-travel trap the spawn brief warned about): the test monkeypatches JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=-1, clears the settings cache, and issues the token through create_access_token itself, so exp is strictly in the past at decode time; monkeypatch + the fixture's second cache_clear() restore state. alg=none is hand-forged (base64url header {'alg':'none','typ':'JWT'} + payload + empty signature) - probed against the locked python-jose 3.5.0: rejected with 'The specified alg value is not allowed' precisely because decode is always called with algorithms=[settings.JWT_ALGORITHM]; a module that read the alg from the token header would fail this node. Wrong-aud/wrong-iss/wrong-secret/expired all confirmed to surface as JWTError subclasses, which the reference decode catches as JWTError -> TokenError.

Builder traps discovered by probing and now documented in the issue: (1) neither jose nor passlib ships py.typed, and mypy strict errors 'Library stubs not installed' - the fix is a FILE-LEVEL '# mypy: disable-error-code="import-untyped"' (the per-import '# type: ignore[import-untyped]' form is REJECTED for module imports: 'Type ignore with error code is not supported for modules'); types-python-jose/types-passlib exist on PyPI but adding them would widen the dependency change beyond the authorized bcrypt pin, so the file-level pragma is mandated instead; (2) a function annotated '-> None' cannot appear in an expression - 'assert verify_dummy(x) is None' fails mypy func-returns-value (reproduced), so the ac2 test calls it as a statement; (3) ruff UP017 requires 'from datetime import UTC' instead of timezone.utc; (4) ruff B017 bans pytest.raises(Exception); (5) jose_jwt.encode returns Any -> needs cast(str, ...); (6) the autouse settings fixture must be a real generator ('-> Iterator[None]' + yield + teardown cache_clear) - 'yield  # type: ignore[misc]' in a '-> None' fixture fails mypy misc. All six were reproduced as failures and resolved in the reference run.
